title: narcissus × litigiosus var. granatensis
intro: Narcissus × litigiosus var. granatensis, commonly known as Narcissus, is a hybrid plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family, derived from the cross between Narcissus pseudonarcissus and Narcissus viridiflorus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and possessing antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus × litigiosus var. granatensis include its ability to act as a vasodilator, reducing blood pressure and improving circulation, as well as its antispasmodic properties, which help to relax muscles and alleviate spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as galantamine, which have been shown to have acetylcholinesterase inhibitory activity and may have potential applications in the treatment of cognitive disorders.
